LanguageData.AT_Setting_ShowOriginal: Show original text on hover (default: Off):
LanguageData.AT_Setting_ShowOriginal_Tooltip: When hovering over translated text, the original text will be displayed. Due to system limitations, this feature is not available for all translations.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_EnableLanguageDetection_Toolt: Automatically detects if text is already in the target language and skips translation. This prevents re-translating content that's already in Korean/Japanese/Chinese etc. when stored in the English folder. Recommended to keep enabled.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_Note: Note: Changes to the settings below require a game restart
LanguageData.AT_Setting_RequiresAPIKey: This translation engine requires an API key.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_RequiresAPIKey_Tooltip: To use multiple API keys in rotation, separate them with commas (,).
LanguageData.AT_Message_LanguageNotSupported: This translator does not support your current language. Please select a different one.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_NoModelFound: No models found. Please verify your API key.
LanguageData.AT_Message_NoModelsFound: No models found. Please check your API key and base URL.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_NoTranslatorError: Translator not found. Please check settings.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_ResetDefCache: Reset all Def caches (if some items are not translated)
LanguageData.AT_Status1: Translation is in progress. You can continue playing normally.
LanguageData.AT_Status2: Translation complete! It's recommended to reset Def caches or restart the game for full application.
LanguageData.AT_Setting_WhiteList: Select mods to translate (applied in real-time)
LanguageData.AT_Message_RetranslateFailed: Cannot retranslate while translation is in progress.
LanguageData.AT_Message_ResetTranslationCache: Translation cache deleted. Please restart the game to begin translation again.
LanguageData.AT_Message_WhiteList_Failed: Translation is in progress and cannot be applied in real-time. Please retry after translation completes, or restart the game.
LanguageData.AT_Message_TestFailed: Test failed. You may have reached the API request limit, or your API key/model may be incorrect.
LanguageData.AT_Message_RestartWork: Restarting translation... (To completely redo, delete the cache first, then restart)
LanguageData.AT_Message_RestartFailed: Restart failed. Please verify your API key and model.
